title: Final Answer (a)
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct final answer for the heat capacity in case (a) as C_v = Nk.

title: Final Answer (b)
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct final answer for the heat capacity in case (b) as C_v = (3/4)Nk.

title: Use of Virial Theorem
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly apply the virial theorem to relate kinetic and potential energy for both cases.

title: Equipartition of Energy
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly apply the equipartition theorem to determine average kinetic energy for one-dimensional motion.

title: Potential Energy Relation
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly identify the potential energy forms V proportional to x^2 and x^4 for cases (a) and (b) respectively.

title: Sign Mistakes
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid sign mistakes in energy calculations or misinterpretation of the virial theorem.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should check that units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Limiting Cases
description: Optional Criteria: The student may discuss limiting cases or special scenarios that could affect the results.
